senses.gloss:
गाथक m. (-कः)
 1. A musician, a singer.
 2. A chanter of the Puranas
or sacred poems.
 E. गै to sing. स्थकन् aff.

गाथा f. (-थां)
 1. A verse, a stanza.
 2. Metre, rhythm.
 3. A song, a chant
or verse to be chanted or sung.
 4. Prakrita or any language not
Sanskrit.
 5. The same as the Aryya Metre, in which the verse con-
tains sixty syllabic instants, variously arranged.
 E. गै to sing, थन्
Uṇādi aff.

गाथाकार m. (-रः) A singer. A reciter.
 E. गाथा, कृ to make, अण् aff.

गाथिक m. (-कः) One who recites Gathas, verses or hymns.
 E. गाथा, and
ठक् aff.
